reels.title: LIFT: Layout-In-Future Video Generation under Large Viewpoint Change via On-Policy Self-Distillation

editorial_notes.reasoning: This paper fits the 'multimodal_diffusion' category (1.78x multiplier). It addresses the fascinating problem of controlling video generation in 3D space, which allows for highly visual, chalkboard-friendly animations of camera movement and object placement.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: What if you could tell an AI not just what to film, but exactly how the camera should move through a scene before it even exists?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A film director using a miniature 3D model set to mark where actors and cameras should travel, then hitting 'play' to bring the scene to life.
